title: Morning Brief — Tuesday, 6 October 2026
description: A new Australia-Japan economic agreement and concerns over rural childcare funding, Queensland's new mandatory mental health reporting reforms for high-risk patients, and the Gold Coast light rail's impact on Burleigh Heads property plus a push for an illegal camping crackdown in Currumbin. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
